claims.claim: The BOI policy rate dataflow is BR, whose published name in the dataflow list is 'ריבית בנק ישראל' / 'BOI interest rate'. It is not BIR.

claims.claim: BIR is 'Interest rates and business volume - exc. housing loans' (ריביות וביצועים - לא לדיור), i.e. commercial-bank credit rates, not the policy rate.

claims.claim: UNIT_MULT is the power of ten a rate is quoted per: 0 for most currencies, 2 for the Japanese yen (per 100 JPY).

claims.claim: Observations are emitted as <Obs TIME_PERIOD OBS_VALUE RELEASE_STATUS></Obs> with a separate closing tag, not self-closed.

The headline CPI is CBS index id 120010 (מדד המחירים לצרכן - כללי), published on the 2024-average base. The same API returns HTTP 200 with "month": null for an unknown index id (verified against id=999999) and HTTP 200 with an HTML body for an undefined path, so callers must validate the payload rather than the status code.

The BOI representative exchange rate is published Monday to Friday and not on Saturday or Sunday, the Israeli financial week having moved to Monday-Friday in January 2026. Verified directly from the series: Friday 2026-08-21 carries an observation and no Saturday or Sunday does.

The representative rate is published Monday-Thursday at approximately 15:30 and Friday at approximately 12:30 Israel time. Carried forward from the v1.3.0 cycle. The BOI methodology page that states these times is behind Radware bot protection and returns a challenge page to any automated fetch, so this cycle could not re-read it verbatim; the publication DAYS are independently API-verified under publication-days-mon-fri.

claims.claim: Reference and data-source URLs cited in the skill. The boi.org.il pages return HTTP 200 to a browser but serve a Radware challenge to automated fetches, so they are cited as human-facing references rather than as machine-readable sources. Covers: https://www.boi.org.il/en/economic-roles/statistical-information/ https://www.boi.org.il/en/communication-and-publications/press-releases/ https://www.boi.org.il/en/economic-roles/monetary-policy/ https://www.boi.org.il/he/economic-roles/statistical-information/ https://www.boi.org.il/he/communication-and-publications/press-releases/ https://www.cbs.gov.il/en/subjects/Pages/Consumer-Price-Index.aspx https://www.cbs.gov.il/he/subjects/Pages/מדד-המחירים-לצרכן.aspx https://www.cbs.gov.il/he/pages/default.aspx https://info.tase.co.il/ https://data.gov.il/ Also covers the API base paths and the CPI query URL as written in the skill: https://edge.boi.gov.il/FusionEdgeServer/ws/public/sdmxapi/rest/data https://edge.boi.gov.il/FusionEdgeServer/ws/public/sdmxapi/rest/data/ https://api.cbs.gov.il/index/data/price https://api.cbs.gov.il/index/data/price?id=120010&format=json&last=6 The two BOI base paths return HTTP 404 on their own by design: a dataflow and a series segment must be appended. The CBS query URL was fetched live and returned the headline index.
The Bank of Israel inflation target upper bound is 3%, published by the BOI as the daily series INF_MAX_TRGT_D in the ZCM dataflow.
The Bank of Israel inflation target lower bound is 1%, published by the BOI as the daily series INF_MIN_TRGT_D in the ZCM dataflow.

claims.claim: A BOI dataflow queried with no date filter returns every series it holds with full history (EXR is about 20 MB, 35 series, 268,629 observations, earliest TIME_PERIOD 1948-05-15), not an empty result. A date-bounded dataflow query returns that dataflow's series for the window: EXR for 2026-08-26 returns 16 series, of which 14 are per-currency RER_<CUR>_ILS rates and 2 are the trade-weighted basket series NER_ILS_BSK_PCT and NER_ILS_BSK_IDX.
